questions.question: In Jerusalem, James and the elders told Paul about four men who had taken a vow. What did they ask Paul to do?

answers.text: Purify himself with them and pay their expenses
Send them out to preach among the Gentiles
Bring them all before the high priest

questions.question: When Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul at the temple in Jerusalem, what did they do?

answers.text: Stirred up the whole crowd and seized him
Asked him to explain his teaching
Reported him to James and the elders

questions.question: Jews from Asia said Paul had defiled the holy temple in Jerusalem. What did they accuse him of doing there?

answers.text: Taking money from the temple treasury

questions.question: When the Roman commander heard that Jerusalem was in turmoil over Paul, what did he do?

answers.text: Ran down to the crowd with soldiers and centurions
Waited for the crowd to calm down
Sent one messenger to find out more
